name: Vast.ai boxes
description: Each rented Vast.ai box on the session that rented it; sessions rent through tools that ask you for a budget, and a hook refuses the CLI.

panels.label: Vast.ai
panels.description: Every Vast.ai box as a card, running or disk only, with its session and actions; what the boxes cost per day or week; each lease on a timeline

menu.label: Rent a Vast.ai machine…

input.title: What do you need the machine for?
input.placeholder: e.g. fine-tune a 4B model for about 3 hours: 24 GB VRAM or more, cheapest reliable host

menu.prompt:
Rent a Vast.ai machine for this request from the user: {input}

Use a subagent (the Agent tool) with the `vastai` skill to search the Vast.ai offers that fit the request (the `vast_offers` tool) and choose the best few, weighing price against what the job needs and the host's reliability. Then call `vast_rent` with the offer ids best first, a short name (at most 8 characters), the image and disk the job needs, `purpose` set to what the request is for, and a suggested `budget` in dollars: the job's real length times the rate, plus a margin, with the reasoning in `purpose`. `vast_rent` shows the user the offers on a card with the budget as an editable field and rents what they pick; do not print a table or ask for a number yourself. Then say which box it is, how long it is leased for, what it costs per hour, the budget they confirmed and how to reach it. If they pick none, ask what to change and search again.
